Expose capabilities without reimplementing them

Exposure rules ensure controllers, endpoints and other boundary adapters translate one incoming interaction into one business call. Branching, looping, broker access and workflow sequencing remain below the transport boundary.

The value of enforcing this family

That gives every protocol the same business behaviour and keeps new exposures inexpensive to add.
